scripts.migrate:preprod: wrangler d1 migrations apply dtx-web-preprod --remote --env pre-prod
scripts.migrate:preprod:prod-data: wrangler d1 migrations apply dtx-web --remote --env pre-prod-prod-data
scripts.deploy:preprod: bun run migrate:preprod && wrangler deploy --env pre-prod
scripts.deploy:preprod:prod-data: bun run migrate:preprod:prod-data && wrangler deploy --env pre-prod-prod-data
scripts.auth:schema:generate: auth generate --config src/auth/auth.cli.ts --output src/auth/schema.ts --adapter drizzle --dialect sqlite --yes
scripts.auth:schema:check: bun run auth:schema:generate && prettier --write src/auth/schema.ts && git diff --exit-code -- src/auth/schema.ts
